source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    TableName,
    SourceSchema,
    SourceTable,
    SinkFolder,
    WatermarkColumn,
    LastWatermarkValue,
    FullLoadFileName,
    LoadType
FROM etl.WatermarkControl
WHERE IsActive = 1;

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@if(
    equals(item().LoadType, 'Full'),
    concat('SELECT * FROM [', item().SourceSchema, '].[', item().SourceTable, ']'),
    concat(
        'SELECT * FROM [',
        item().SourceSchema,
        '].[',
        item().SourceTable,
        '] WHERE [',
        item().WatermarkColumn,
        '] >= CONVERT(datetime2(3), ''',
        formatDateTime(item().LastWatermarkValue, 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fff'),
        ''', 126)'
    )
)
